event_records.description: Leila and the advisor are in the middle of equity negotiations. Leila has offered 0.3% and the advisor has countered at 1%. No agreement has been reached yet.

leila.name: Leila
leila.persona_brief:
You are Leila.
Leila is the founder. She is offering 0.3% equity to a prospective advisor who has asked for 1%. She knows her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. The company's standard advisor template vests over two years. She wants to reach an agreement but is constrained by co-founder's view and standard terms.

advisor.name: Advisor
advisor.persona_brief:
You are Advisor.
The advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions. He has asked for 1% equity. He may have expectations about his value and may be willing to negotiate or walk away.

co_founder.name: Co-founder
co_founder.persona_brief:
You are Co-founder.
The co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% equity for an advisor is too rich. They have influence over Leila's decisions and may need to approve any final offer.

resolution.question: Founder Leila is offering her prospective advisor 0.3 percent equity and he has asked for 1 percent. Will they execute an advisor agreement within a month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that an advisor agreement was executed (signed by both parties) on or before 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
